on_screen_text.text: 🇵🇷 🇵🇷 Puerto Rican PA voter is DONE with Trump after his Madison Square Garden rally 👇👇👇
A LOOK AT WHETHER COMMENTS AT NYC TRUMP RALLY COULD SWAY VOTES
Voter: I was leaning toward voting for Trump, but not anymore. Puerto Rico means a lot to me. Those comments at Madison Square Garden changed everything. I have to stand on the right side of history.

spoken_summary: A woman identified as Jinelly Lugo, a Puerto Rican voter in Philadelphia, explains that Puerto Rico means a lot to her and other Puerto Ricans living on the mainland. A narrator states that Lugo was leaning toward voting for Trump, but his comments at a recent rally changed her mind. Lugo says that the day of the rally "changed everything" and she decided she has to be on "the right side of history."
audio_music: The audio consists of dialogue from an interview and a reporter's narration, with subtle, neutral background music typical of a broadcast news segment.

central_claim: A Puerto Rican voter in Pennsylvania, who was previously considering voting for Donald Trump, has decided against it because of his comments at a Madison Square Garden rally.
intended_effect: To highlight that Donald Trump's rhetoric is alienating potential supporters, particularly within the Latino community in a key swing state.
